claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Losartan is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent at 2.5 uM; its only plausible antiproliferative effect is weak, non-selective modulation of tumour stroma/vasculature rather than direct cancer cell killing.
